method: TypeScript compiler API with type checker (ts.createProgram + program.getTypeChecker()). Receivers resolved by type; a property access is counted only when the checker resolves the member symbol to a declaration on the ConfigBaseCore -> ConfigBase -> Config hierarchy. This catches receivers reached through deps properties (this.deps.config.x), forwarding (unannotated locals holding Config), aliased imports, Pick<Config,...> narrowings, and union types (Config | undefined) via optional chaining.
